visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three people, two men and one woman, are dressed in khaki safari-style outfits, posing playfully in front of a lush jungle backdrop labeled 'Jurassic World.' The woman in the center wears a wide-brimmed straw hat and mimics a dinosaur claw gesture with her hands. (2) The scene cuts to the woman looking shocked with wide eyes and her hands on her face as if seeing something frightening, while the lighting is bright indoor studio lighting. (3) The characters walk past a white SUV with 'ENTER THE EXTREME' branding in an urban outdoor setting. (4) Close-ups show dinosaur-themed gourmet food; a yellow mango sauce is drizzled onto a plated dish, and melted chocolate is poured over a large egg-shaped dessert that cracks open. (5) On a boat in a river under overcast skies, the woman wearing a plastic raincoat points at a large Spinosaurus fin appearing in the water while screaming with high facial arousal. (6) In a lobby, a staff member in uniform holds a detailed baby dinosaur puppet that moves realistically, as the woman looks on in awe and talks to him. (7) Thai actor Nadech Kugimiya, wearing a brown jacket and white shirt, greets the group in a stylish hotel lobby with warm lighting. (8) The video concludes with a large group selfie of influencers in front of a movie poster and a final shot of the woman jumping on a rope bridge.
